rules.name: A consolidation is an internal range between a defined high and low where directional intent is unresolved
rules.setupAnchor: After expansion or at an important higher-timeframe level, price compresses and remains internal between a defined high and low for multiple rotations
rules.confirmationTrigger: Treat price as consolidating while it stays inside the range, returns toward equilibrium, and fails to produce a decisive continuation or reversal sequence
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: No directional protected swing should be trusted until the range either manipulates one side and confirms away from it or breaks out cleanly and holds the retest
rules.invalidationCondition: Price resolves with a confirmed manipulation plus closure through the opposing candle series, or breaks out and refuses to close back inside the range
rules.targetLogic: Inside the range, avoid directional trades; once consolidation resolves, target the next external liquidity pool away from the resolved side
exceptions: A brief pause after expansion is not enough on its own to classify a full consolidation
If price never returns toward equilibrium and instead displaces immediately, the phase is likely already resolving
machineChecks: Track whether price remains internal between a stable range high and range low
Measure whether price keeps reverting toward range equilibrium instead of displacing decisively
Block directional entries while consolidation remains unresolved

rules.name: The preferred consolidation setup is a sweep of one side of the range followed by confirmation away from the swept side
rules.setupAnchor: Mark the active range and wait for liquidity sweep or correlated-market SMT sweep on one side of that range
rules.confirmationTrigger: After the sweep, require a close through the opposing candle series or protected swing formation before trading away from the taken side
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The protected swing that forms after the sweep confirms whether the event is a manipulation leading to continuation or reversal
rules.invalidationCondition: Price sweeps a side but closes back into the range without directional confirmation, or rotates to the opposite side before holding the new swing
rules.targetLogic: Enter after confirmation and target the opposite external liquidity or the next higher-timeframe objective away from the manipulated side
exceptions: SMT can substitute for a direct sweep in the instrument being traded
A wick alone is not enough; the close through the opposing series is still required
machineChecks: Require a sweep or validated SMT substitute before manipulation logic is enabled
Require closure through the opposing candle series before entry eligibility
Reject setups that sweep a side but keep rotating across the full range

rules.name: A breakout continuation is valid when price leaves the range, holds outside it, and confirms on the retest
rules.setupAnchor: Price approaches a range boundary while the broader bias and prior expansion still favor one side
rules.confirmationTrigger: Price breaks the range, does not close back inside it, and forms continuation structure on the retest of the broken boundary
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: The first protected swing that forms outside the range becomes the breakout invalidation level
rules.invalidationCondition: Price breaks out but closes back inside the range or fails to hold the new protected swing on retest
rules.targetLogic: Trade the retest in the breakout direction and target external liquidity in line with the prevailing trend
exceptions: Failure to manipulate can still be a valid breakout if price refuses to return inside the range
A breakout without retest confirmation is lower quality than a held retest
machineChecks: Require an outside close before treating the move as a valid breakout
Reject breakout continuation if price closes back inside the range
Promote retest entries only after the broken boundary holds as support or resistance

rules.name: While consolidation remains unresolved, equilibrium and range-rotation behavior should dominate expectations
rules.setupAnchor: An internal range forms and both sides are still available as liquidity targets
rules.confirmationTrigger: Until breakout or manipulation confirms, expect deviations from the range to revert toward equilibrium or daily-open style rebalancing points
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: If no new directional protected swing forms, the environment remains rotational rather than directional
rules.invalidationCondition: Price stops rotating around equilibrium and instead confirms a directional move with range escape plus structural confirmation
rules.targetLogic: Either stand aside or fade false breakouts back toward equilibrium; do not chase directional continuation while the range is still behaving like seek-and-destroy or whipsaw conditions
exceptions: Seek-and-destroy conditions are better treated as non-opportunity than as mandatory fade trades
If London or another early session already creates most of the day's range, later-session expansion expectations should be reduced
machineChecks: Track equilibrium reversion while price remains internal to the range
Lower expansion expectations after repeated false breakouts or two-sided sweeps
Block continuation-style entries while no directional protected swing exists

How should the project rank direct sweep evidence versus SMT substitute evidence when both can stand in for range manipulation?
